summary.en: Detective Takagi comes back to the police department after an all night stakeout and gets reprimanded by Detective Sato for his poorly appearance. She then starts fixing his necktie, only for him to get flustered when he notices a group of other male policemen (save for Shiratori) giving him death glares out of jealousy.

suspects: Kikuna Kagitani, Ryoko Takimoto, and Ryusuke Kodama
suspectsZh: 键谷菊奈、泷本凉子与小玉龙介
